```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")

bird_breeding_selected <- sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude) |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")

gt(bird_breeding_selected)

#gt(sites)
#colnames(sites)
#glimpse(sites)
#print(nrow(sites)) ##row number
#print(ncol(sites)) ##column number
#print(dim(sites)) ##dimensions
```

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

connectivity <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")

migration_sites <- connectivity |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude = awestlat) |>
  filter(Site != "Spain") |>
  group_by(Site)

gt(migration_sites)
glimpse(migration_sites)


bird_migration_summary <- migration_sites |>
  group_by(Site) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        Stopover_Longitude, Stopover_Latitude,
        Iberian_Longitude, Iberian_Latitude,
        Westmost_Longitude, Westmost_Latitude,
        Winter_Longitude, Winter_Latitude
      ),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_selected, bird_migration_summary)

combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)

spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)

autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)

write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")

```
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()
max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()
min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()
max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, colour = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
    ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site), linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

min_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()
max_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()
min_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()
max_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(
  autumn_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, colour = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
    ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site), linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
birds <- tibble(
  Bird = c("Robin", "Robin", "Blackbird"),
  Mass = c(18, 19, 100)
)

observations <- tibble(
  Bird = c("Robin", "Robin", "Robin", "Blackbird"),
  Count = c(4, 7, 2, 5)
)

inner_join(birds, observations, by = "Bird")
```
